description:
Fetch gnomAD loss-of-function constraint for a gene — pLI, LOEUF (oe_lof_upper, the headline metric) with its lower bound and the LOEUF percentile, observed/expected ratios for LoF, missense, and synonymous variation with the missense and synonymous intervals, the observed and expected counts, and the three Z-scores. This is the orthogonal axis to allele frequency: a loss-of-function variant matters far more in a gene intolerant to being broken. Accepts an HGNC symbol (PCSK9) or an Ensembl gene ID (ENSG00000169174). gnomAD recommends LOEUF < 0.45 to call a gene LoF-intolerant on v4.1.2 and LOEUF < 0.35 on v2.1.1; on exac, pLI is the intolerance measure: ExAC publishes only pLI, the Z-scores, and observed/expected counts, so every other metric is null there and constraint_flags is empty. A mitochondrial gene (MT-CO1, MT-TL1) carries gnomAD’s mitochondrial constraint in mitochondrial_constraint instead of nuclear metrics. Many genes lack some metrics upstream; those fields are null, never fabricated.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset, default gnomad_r4: gnomad_r4 and its subset gnomad_r4_non_ukb (GRCh38); gnomad_r3 and its subsets gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2 (GRCh38); gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed (GRCh37); exac (GRCh37). A subset keeps part of its parent release's samples (non_cancer drops cancer-study samples, non_ukb UK Biobank's) and can leave a callset unchanged: gnomad_r4_non_ukb genome counts equal gnomad_r4's, and gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer genome counts equal gnomad_r2_1's.

gene.description: Gene — HGNC symbol (e.g. PCSK9) or Ensembl gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000169174). Obtain a stable ID from ensembl_lookup_gene.

reference_genome.description: Reference build, derived from dataset when omitted; a build other than the dataset's is rejected. Keep aligned with Ensembl coordinates.

name: gnomad_get_gene_constraint

constraint_flags.description: Caveat flags gnomAD attaches to the gene’s constraint (e.g. no_exp_lof, mis_too_many, syn_outlier); empty when none.

constraint_release.description: Constraint release the nuclear metrics come from: gnomAD v4.1.2 for gnomad_r4, gnomad_r3 (gnomAD publishes no v3 constraint), and their subsets; gnomAD v2.1.1 for gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets; ExAC r0.3 for exac. A subset reads its parent release’s table, since gnomAD publishes no subset constraint. It labels the nuclear tables only, never mitochondrial_constraint.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `gene_not_found`: No gene matched the symbol or Ensembl ID in this build. `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_constraint_data`: gnomAD returned constraint metrics outside their valid ranges (such as a pLI above 1), or a mitochondrial constraint of a shape its schema does not define. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the constraint query with a GraphQL error. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s call budget expired. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

gene_id.description: Ensembl gene ID resolved for the gene.

anyOf.description: Constraint for a protein-coding mitochondrial gene.

oe_lof_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_lof.

oe_lof_upper.description: Upper bound (OEUF) of the 90% interval around oe_lof.

oe_mis_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_mis.

oe_mis_upper.description: Upper bound (OEUF) of the 90% interval around oe_mis.

oe_syn_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_syn.

oe_syn_upper.description: Upper bound of the 90% interval around oe_syn.

anyOf.description: Constraint for a tRNA or rRNA mitochondrial gene.

oe_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe.

oe_upper.description: Upper bound (OEUF) of the 90% interval around oe.

anyOf.description: No mitochondrial constraint: the gene is nuclear.

mitochondrial_constraint.description: gnomAD’s mitochondrial gene constraint, from 56,434 gnomAD v4.1 genomes; null for a nuclear gene. kind protein carries stop-gain (lof; splice variants do not apply in mtDNA), missense (mis), and synonymous (syn) sets, kind rna one set over all SNVs. Observed and expected are sums of maximum heteroplasmy over every possible SNV, not variant counts, and the intervals come from a beta distribution, so the nuclear LOEUF thresholds do not apply; gnomAD reads the upper bound (OEUF) as the conservative measure, lower meaning stronger selection. The same table on every dataset, exac included.

oe_lof_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_lof.

oe_lof_percentile.description: Percentile bin of the gene’s LOEUF among gnomAD v4.1.2’s MANE Select transcripts; lower is more constrained (KMT2A is 0, FLG is 98). Only v4.1.2 publishes it, so it is null on every GRCh37 dataset and wherever LOEUF is null.

oe_lof_upper.description: LOEUF, the upper bound of the 90% interval around oe_lof and the headline intolerance metric; lower is more constrained.

oe_mis_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_mis.

oe_mis_upper.description: Upper bound of the 90% interval around oe_mis.

oe_syn_lower.description: Lower bound of the 90% interval around oe_syn.

oe_syn_upper.description: Upper bound of the 90% interval around oe_syn.

pli.description: Probability of LoF intolerance; above 0.9 is intolerant.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: get gene constraint
